speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with mental status changes; to begin our assessment, how long have you noticed these symptoms, and have there been any recent head injuries or fever?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old female. The patient has been brought to the emergency room by her family due to altered mental status. The family mentions that she has been increasingly confused over the past few days. No recent head trauma or known drug use. The patient has a smoking history of 30 pack-years.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Carbon monoxide poisoning is highly suspected given the acute confusion, lack of other trauma/drug causes, and significant smoking history. I need to confirm this immediately. REQUEST TEST: Carboxyhemoglobin level, Arterial Blood Gas, and CBC with platelets.
